recognize_zh: 淋巴結副皮質區可見深染小淋巴球與許多核較大、染色質淡、細胞質淡染的細胞（交指狀樹突細胞/組織球）混雜，並有粉紅色高內皮小靜脈穿插，形成斑駁（mottled）外觀，無濾泡結構。
features: Small lymphocytes with round dense nuclei and scant cytoplasm
Numerous larger cells with pale vesicular, oval to folded nuclei and pale cytoplasm (interdigitating dendritic cells/histiocytes)
Eosinophilic high endothelial venules traversing the field
Mottled pattern produced by the mix of dark lymphocytes and pale cells
No follicles, granulomas, or atypical large cells
describe_en: Section of lymph node at medium-high power shows paracortical tissue composed of small lymphocytes admixed with numerous larger pale cells with vesicular, oval to folded nuclei, consistent with interdigitating dendritic cells and histiocytes, and traversed by high endothelial venules. The mixture imparts a mottled appearance. No follicles, granulomas or atypical large cells are identified. Findings are consistent with normal lymph node paracortex.

ddx.vs: Dermatopathic change forms expanded pale paracortical nodules rich in S100/CD1a-positive Langerhans cells with melanin-laden macrophages.
PTCL shows atypical medium-to-large T cells with irregular nuclei effacing the node, often with loss of pan-T antigens, unlike the bland mixed population here.
cHL contains Hodgkin/Reed-Sternberg cells with macronucleoli in a mixed background, which are not seen in this field.
